items.label: Benefits
items.value: Said to help with neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain, poor circulation, recovery from illness, cuts, burns, chronic skin conditions, and more, as well as gastrointestinal issues and chronic muscular rheumatism.

items.label: Onsen Characteristics
items.value: Known for its smooth feel on the skin. High heat-retention means you stay warm long after bathing, making it a good choice for elderly guests and families.

items.label: Source Information
items.value: Continuously fed with fresh spring water (kakenagashi), drawn from a source welling up in Toyako Onsen town on the shore of Lake Toya within Shikotsu-Toya National Park.

items.name: Large Public Bath
items.description: Our large public bath, fed continuously with fresh spring water, has three tubs of different temperatures for both men and women — hot, warm, and skin-temperature. Take your time and choose the one that suits how you feel that day.
items.hours: 13:00–9:30 the next day (closed 23:00–23:30 and 9:30–13:00 for cleaning)

items.name: Bubble Bath
items.description: Enjoy our soothing bubble bath. Pair it with the onsen for an even deeper level of relaxation.

items.name: Open-air Bath
items.description: Soak in our open-air bath while feeling the breeze off the lake. Enjoy views of Lake Toya and the surrounding mountains by day, and quiet steam under the starry sky by night.

items.label: Hours
items.value: Large public bath: 13:00–9:30 the next day (closed 23:00–23:30 and 9:30–13:00 for cleaning) / Open-air bath: 13:00–23:00

items.label: Amenities
items.value: Bath and face towels are provided in your room. Shampoo, conditioner, body soap, and lotion are provided in the bathing area. You may move around the hotel in your yukata.

items.label: Usage Notes
items.value: Guests with tattoos, or who have recently consumed alcohol, are asked to refrain from bathing. To prevent overheating, we recommend staying hydrated.

dayUse.heading: For Day-trip Bathing Guests

items.label: Usage Notes
items.value: Guests with tattoos, or who have recently consumed alcohol, are asked to refrain from bathing. We may decline day-trip bathing during busy periods or on special days — thank you for your understanding.

notes: Shampoo, conditioner, body soap, and hair dryers are provided free of charge.
